'''Draedon Power Cells''' are [[consumable]] items that are generated by the [[Power Cell Factory]]. When used and correctly input at the [[Charging Station]], it is able to add 1 unit of [[charge]] to chargeable [[weapons]] per power cell. It can also be used at an [[Extractinator]] to obtain a renewable supply of [[Dubious Plating]] and [[Mysterious Circuitry]].

Additionally, Draedon Power Cells are used to decrypt [[Schematics]] at the [[Codebreaker]].

== Notes ==
*The charging process can be stopped mid charge and keeps all previous progress.
*Draedon Power Cells get used at an Extractinator at an incredibly fast rate compared to other items.

== Tips ==
*It is much more profitable to run Draedon Power Cells through an Extractinator, as opposed to just selling them.
**A Power Cell run through an Extractinator will always produce at least 65 copper coins worth of items, more than triple its sell price. On average, Power Cells produce 109.7 copper coins in coins and sellable materials.
**This means that a single Power Cell Factory produces an average of almost 3 gold coins worth of materials and coins per hour. However, a player will usually have multiple factories running once since most [[Arsenal Labs]] are supposed to contain at least two, and there are multiple labs scattered across a world.
